mechanism: A structured {{protocol}} for causal discovery. Unlike {{verification}}, which confirms a claim already made, Experiment generates a {{solution}} by comparing a control group against a treatment group differing in the variable under test and, so far as declared, nothing else.
gloss: Structured causal discovery via variable isolation
invariants: Control and treatment differ in the variable under test; every other difference is eliminated or written down.
The design commits in advance to learning from either outcome.
failure_modes: Undeclared difference: something varied that the design did not name, so no cause is established.
Mechanism assumed: the comparison shows the variable mattered, not why.
